text:
deploy-bot: Rollout complete for prod-fastpath (v2026-03-10-rc3). Canary 100% across regions. Summary: CPU/GPU warmup applied, staggered instance warmup. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-10-rc3 :rocket:

anna-w: hitting smoke failures on the synthetic runner for embed-route in eu-west, 4/10 failures, p95 ~2.1s (was ~0.9s pre-deploy).

miguel: curious if this is the staggered warmup timing — we set warmup-window=30s for this traffic class.

sarah: quick look at host fastpath-12 logs shows repeated GC pauses and higher prefix-cache miss rate. not OOM but GC spikes.

josh: confirmed GC pauses ~120-180ms every ~10s, correlates with the synth failures (requests hitting GC windows).

priya: can we pin eu-west to previous stable v2026-03-09 while we triage? minimizes customer impact.

anna-w: +1. propose: pin routing for embed-eu to v2026-03-09, keep other regions on rc3. we can allow canary traffic subset in us-west for validation.

dennis-sre: agree. quick health checks to run before/after pin:
```
curl -sS https://prod-fastpath.eu-west.redwood/api/health | jq .
curl -sS 'https://prod-fastpath.eu-west.redwood/generate' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"prompt":"smoke test","max_tokens":10}' | jq .
```

deploy-bot: Pin action executed: route embed-eu -> v2026-03-09 (manual pin). action_id=pin-455, expiry=manual. Routing change propagated to eu-west edge in ~12s.

anna-w: starting 15m stabilization window to watch metrics. if p95 and error-rate don't return to baseline, we'll escalate to rollback.

miguel: I'll flip config to increase KV prefetch and extend warmup to 120s for the follow-up patch. will prepare a small canary with those warmup settings.

sarah: pushing a short-lived dashboard with the probe breakdown and host-level GC metrics, tagging the thread #eng-releases #incidents.

priya: :+1: thanks team, good catch.

josh: after pin, p95 in eu-west dropped to ~1.05s and synth failures down to 1/50 in the live runner. looks like pin helped. continuing to watch.

deploy-bot: Note: continuing to route 30% of us-west traffic to v2026-03-10-rc3 for additional verification.

anna-w: SG. if errors >1% or p95 >1.5s for 30m straight we will rollback fully. logging follow-up action items in the release notes and schedule a postmortem if we need a rollback.

(automatic) deploy-bot: threading summary added to release: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-10-rc3/notes (pin action logged)

anna-w: Thanks all — I'll update the release changelog and coordinate the follow-up patch with Miguel.
